explore-flow.title: Close the loop
explore-flow.prompt: Close the switch and watch the ammeter.
hints: Use the switch control under the circuit.
explore-flow.success: The loop is complete, so charge flows. That flow is current.

explore-drop.title: Voltage drops along the way
explore-drop.prompt: Turn the battery up to 12 V. How is it shared between R1 and R2?
hints: Turn the battery voltage knob all the way up.
explore-drop.success: 4 V drops across R1 and 8 V across R2: the bigger resistor takes the bigger share, and the drops add up to 12 V.
